headline: AGNICO EAGLE SMASHES Q3 ESTIMATES — $1.35B NET INCOME, $852M FREE CASH FLOW, EPS BEATS BY $0.06
snippet: Agnico Eagle (TSX/NYSE: AEM) reported Q3 net income of US$1.35 billion ($2.67 per share), up 28% year-over-year, with adjusted EPS of $2.62 beating consensus by $0.06 on record realized gold prices above $4,000; free cash flow of $852 million brings full-year shareholder distributions expected to top 50% of FCF, with production tracking near the low end of 2026 guidance at 814,012 ounces and a cash balance of $3.6 billion against only $197 million in debt.

headline: GOLD DROPS TO $4,035 AS FED VOTES 10-2 TO HOLD — HAWKISH SURPRISE; DECEMBER HIKE NOW 84% LIKELY
snippet: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate at 3.75%–4.00% in a 10-2 vote, with Governors Cook and Hammack dissenting in favor of an immediate hike — a hawkish surprise that knocked spot gold down to $4,035 and lifted December-hike odds to 84% on CME FedWatch; September PCE inflation data is due today and will set the next direction for bullion with oil-driven inflation fears already weighing on the metal.

headline: RIO TINTO OPENS DLE LITHIUM PLANTS IN ARGENTINA — FIRST MAJOR-SCALE DIRECT LITHIUM EXTRACTION OUTSIDE CHINA
snippet: Rio Tinto (ASX/NYSE: RIO) inaugurated two direct lithium extraction plants at its Sal de Vida (15,000 t/yr carbonate) and Fénix 1B operations in Catamarca province, Argentina, positioning itself as one of the first major miners to commercialize large-scale DLE technology; the launches arrive alongside lingering industry questions about DLE cost curves and long-term scalability, with Rio's larger Rincón project targeting first production in 2028.

headline: KINROSS STUMBLES IN Q3 — PRODUCTION DOWN 16% TO 424,693 OZ AS FORT KNOX AND BALD MOUNTAIN WEIGH
snippet: Kinross Gold (TSX/NYSE: K) reported Q3 gold-equivalent production of 424,693 ounces, down 16% from 503,862 ounces a year earlier on planned lower throughput at Fort Knox and Bald Mountain; operating cash flow fell to $714.4 million from $1.02 billion in Q3 2025, though the company deployed approximately $230 million in share buybacks during the quarter.

headline: NEWCORE GOLD HITS 9m AT 5.10 g/t INSIDE 37m AT 2.16 g/t — ENCHI GHANA DISCOVERY RUNS OUTSIDE RESOURCE BOUNDARY
snippet: Newcore Gold (TSXV: NCAU) intersected 37.0 metres at 2.16 g/t gold including 9.0 metres at 5.10 g/t at its Enchi gold project in Ghana; the high-grade intercept sits outside the current mineral resource boundary and has not been incorporated into the preliminary feasibility study, suggesting the resource footprint has room to grow ahead of any updated estimate.

headline: BLOSSOM GOLD: 128m AT 1.19 g/t WITH 37.1m AT 2.82 g/t — ROSEBUD NEVADA HEAP-LEACH NEARLY DOUBLES RESOURCE AVERAGE GRADE
snippet: Blossom Gold (TSXV: BGAU) returned 128 metres at 1.19 g/t gold — including 37.1 metres at 2.82 g/t — in a surface drill hole at its Rosebud open-pit, heap-leach project in Nevada; the company notes the intersection is nearly twice the average grade of the current resource over the same interval length, adding to a year of expanding results at the Elko County project.

headline: FIVE AFRICAN COUNTRIES OPENED GOLD REFINERIES IN 2026 — ETHIOPIA TARGETING 600 TONNES PER YEAR
snippet: A GoldSeek analysis details how five African nations launched domestic gold refining capacity in 2026, led by Ethiopia where a new refinery is targeting annual throughput of more than 600 tonnes of precious metals; the buildout reflects a continent-wide push to capture more value chain domestically rather than shipping raw doré to European and Dubai refiners — a structural shift that could redirect future gold flows.

headline: VENARI MINERALS EXTRACTS 99.1% LITHIUM IN HCl LEACH TESTS AT RED MOUNTAIN, NEVADA
snippet: Venari Minerals (ASX: VMS) reported hydrochloric acid leach tests extracting 99.1% of lithium from samples at its Red Mountain project in Nevada; the result follows an October 6 resource update that added strontium and magnesium credits to the asset — potentially improving processing economics — as the company advances toward a definitive feasibility study.

headline: AUREKA BUYS FIDDLERS CREEK GOLD MINE PLUS WEDDERBURN GOLD MILL IN VICTORIA — COMPLETING OCT 30
snippet: Aureka Ltd. (ASX: AKA) received shareholder approval to acquire High Grade Holdings and expects to close the transaction on or around October 30; the deal delivers the producing Fiddlers Creek gold mine alongside the Wedderburn gold processing mill in Victoria — rare combined mine-and-mill infrastructure control for a small ASX junior.

headline: MYRIAD URANIUM DRILLS 34.3m AT 399 PPM U3O8 — COPPER MOUNTAIN WYOMING PHASE II ADVANCING
snippet: Myriad Uranium (TSXV: MYRUF) announced further Phase II preliminary drill results from its Copper Mountain uranium project in Wyoming, headlined by a mineralized interval of 34.3 metres at 399 ppm eU3O8; the program is ongoing in the Wind River Basin — a uranium-prospective district — and the company is targeting a resource update incorporating the current drilling.

headline: BTU METALS STARTS DRILLING AT HUBCAP IN WAWA — TARGETING GOLD MINERALIZATION ADJACENT TO KINROSS/RPX ZONE
snippet: BTU Metals (TSXV: BTU) commenced its initial reverse-circulation drill program at the 100%-owned Hubcap property in Wawa, Ontario, directly adjacent to a Kinross/RPX gold zone; geophysical surveys identified several chargeability anomalies along strike from known mineralization, and results from this first program will determine whether the area warrants a follow-up campaign.
